Place: a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan, a chain railing and a misty gorge below
Time of day: an overcast day — soft, shadowless grey-white light; soft even light, colours calm, no hard shadows.

COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; looking back over her own right shoulder — the shoulder on the image's right side, the upper one as she lies: her chin comes to rest just above that shoulder, which dips slightly toward the camera, and her upper back turns a little with her head so her shoulder blade and the curve of her spine show, while her hips stay turned away — a natural, unhurried glance back; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her chest stays turned away — never a full twist that squares her chest to the camera; the look-back comes from her head and a slight turn of her upper back only.

LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the image's left side, mostly hidden behind her body — at most its hand shows beside her hip.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a bowl of rice low at her side; it is all she holds.

GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: a playful wink with a small smile. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive. Brows relaxed and even, neither raised on one side nor furrowed; lips softly closed or only just parted.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, armor, regalia, ornaments, mecha plates or background. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

LOOK-BACK: her back is toward the camera and her head turns at most a quarter turn over one shoulder — the face shows in profile or three-quarter view, never full-front on a back-facing torso. Her chin sits just above the near shoulder, the far eye and cheek may be partly hidden, the side of the neck shows the turn and the shoulder line continues behind the head. Where her eyes go follows GAZE.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.
